description: This file declares the interface for handling output files within the sparse file system, including functions for opening, writing chunks, and closing output files. It also includes function declarations for reading data from file descriptors.

methods.name: output_file_open_fd
methods.description: Opens an output file for writing, given a file descriptor, block size, length, and various flags.

methods.name: output_file_open_callback
methods.description: Opens an output file with a custom write callback function, along with related parameters.

methods.name: write_data_chunk
methods.description: Writes a data chunk of specified length to the output file.

methods.name: write_fill_chunk
methods.description: Writes a fill chunk with a specified fill value.

methods.name: write_file_chunk
methods.description: Writes a chunk from a file at a given offset.

methods.name: write_fd_chunk
methods.description: Writes a chunk from a file descriptor at a given offset.

methods.name: write_skip_chunk
methods.description: Writes a skip chunk of a specified length.

methods.name: output_file_close
methods.description: Closes the output file, releasing resources.
